sentences.text: Counsel for Opposite Party(s) :
G.A. Hon'Ble Raj Beer Singh, J. 1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material brought on record.

2.  The present second bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 176 of 2021, under Sections 376-AB, 120-B, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, P.S. Sarai Khwaja, District Jaunpur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

The first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court on merits vide order dated 14.03.2024.
3.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and falsely implicated in this case.
The alleged incident has been shown of 14.06.2020 but first information report was lodged by the informant after about one year on 02.06.2021.
The allegation that the applicant has committed rape upon the victim, is wholly false.
The victim has not sustained any injury.
After rejection of the first bail application of applicant, statement of victim girl has been recorded before the trial court.

Learned counsel has referred part cross-examination of victim /
PW-2 and submitted that no case for rape is made out and even if her version is believed it is a case of mere molestation.

It is further submitted that applicant is in jail since 03.01.2022 and thus, he has already undergone the detention of more than three and a half years and that trial of the case is likely to take sufficient long time in its conclusion.
Lastly, it was submitted that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.

4. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and argued that victim is a ten years old minor girl and in her statement before the trial court she has made categorical statement that applicant has committed rape upon her.
Applicant is uncle of victim girl.
It was submitted that copy of the first bail rejection order, wherein direction for speedy trial was made, has not been produced before the trial court.
5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, age and statement of victim girl and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, no case for grant of bail is made out.

Accordingly,
the instant second bail application filed on behalf of applicant Raju Agrahari is hereby rejected.
